units.source_text: 天色向晓，风势稍静，但阵雨陆续不绝。

en.t: As dawn drew near, the wind eased a little, but passing showers continued without pause.

units.source_text: 家臣们互相告道：“六条院里的离屋吹倒了！”

en.t: The retainers told one another, "A detached building at Rokujo-in has been blown down!"

units.source_text: 夕雾闻之，吃了一惊，

en.t: Yugiri heard this and was startled,

units.source_text: 他想：“在此风势猖獗之时，

en.t: and he thought, "At a time when the wind is raging like this,

units.source_text: 六条院的高楼大厦之中，只有父亲所居之处警卫森严，可以放心。

en.t: among the grand buildings of Rokujo-in, only the place where my father lives is heavily guarded and can be considered safe.

units.source_text: 东院的继母那里人手稀少，定然非常恐慌。”

en.t: At my stepmother's quarters in the eastern residence there are few attendants, so she must be terribly frightened."

units.source_text: 他便在曙色苍茫中前去探望。

en.t: So he went to visit her through the dim gray light of dawn.

units.source_text: 途中冷雨横吹，侵入车中。

en.t: On the way, cold rain blew sideways and swept into the carriage.

units.source_text: 天空暗淡，景色凄惨。

en.t: The sky was dark, and the scene looked bleak and desolate.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得心情有些怪异，

en.t: Yugiri felt that something in his own heart was strangely unsettled,

units.source_text: 想道：“为了何事呢？

en.t: and wondered, "What is this about?

units.source_text: 难道我心中又添了一种相思？”

en.t: Can it be that another longing has entered my heart?"

units.source_text: 忽念此乃不应有之事，

en.t: Then he suddenly realized that this was something that should not be,

units.source_text: 便自己申斥：“可恶，荒唐之极！”

en.t: and scolded himself, "Damn it, how utterly absurd!"

units.source_text: 于是一路上东想西想，向六条院前进，

en.t: Thus, turning one thought after another over in his mind, he proceeded toward Rokujo-in,

units.source_text: 首先来到了东院的继母那里。

en.t: and first arrived at his stepmother's quarters in the eastern residence.

units.source_text: 花散里恐怖得很，愁容满面。

en.t: Hanachirusato was terribly frightened, her face full of worry.

units.source_text: 夕雾百般慰藉，又召唤家人，

en.t: Yugiri comforted her in every possible way, then summoned the household attendants,

units.source_text: 吩咐他们把各损坏之处加以修缮。

en.t: and ordered them to repair all the damaged places.

units.source_text: 然后再赴南院参见父亲。

en.t: After that he went on to the southern residence to call on his father.
